name: Smite of Divine Judgement Inquisitor
summary: Smite of Divine Judgement is a lightning melee strike that calls a second bolt down on nearby enemies, so one swing hits the pack and the rare behind it. The Inquisitor critical package ignores elemental resistances, and the build needs no unique.

pros.text: One swing hits the target and the enemies around it.
Inquisitor critical strikes ignore elemental resistances.
No required unique; a rare mace and shield carry the build.
Physical-to-lightning conversion and Shockwave scale together.
A shield and Consecrated Ground give it more defence than a two-hander.
The same mace and shield serve any later lightning attack build.

cons.text: Melee range means you take the hits you are trying to dodge.
Single-target needs the critical package to be online.
Elemental reflect maps are a hard no.
Mana is tight before leech and reduced cost are sorted.
The build wants a six-link for its best damage.
Lightning-resistant bosses slow the fight noticeably.

summary.text: Smite of Divine Judgement measures 11.4k at red maps and 21.1k at pinnacle. The Inquisitor critical package ignores elemental resistances, and the build needs no unique.

leveling.text: Level with Static Strike, then switch to Smite of Divine Judgement once the links are in place; Shockwave carries the area damage and Ancestral Call covers the campaign. The first checkpoint measures 347 life and 35 damage; the second measures 344.

maps.text: At red maps the build measures 11.4k damage, 17359 effective life and 8617 physical max hit. Smite into the pack, keep the shield up, and let the second bolt finish the stragglers.

bossing.text: Pinnacle measures 21.1k damage with 21376 effective life and 8544 physical max hit. Stand in your Consecrated Ground, keep War Banner down, and strike on cooldown.
